requirements.text: The system shall provide a web-based portal user interface for all system functions.
The system shall use the Globus toolkit for secure and reliable communication with remote computing resources.
The system shall integrate with the NCAR Gatekeeper account system for user authentication.
The system shall require users to have an NCAR Gatekeeper account and be approved by a Grid-BGC administrator to access the system.
The system shall enforce a three-attempt lockout policy for user login, requiring administrator intervention to unlock.
The system shall support two user roles: User and Administrator.
The system shall use the NCAR Mass Storage System (MSS) for all file-based storage.
The system shall implement a state-based data integrity model (Unlocked, Locked, Invalidated) to prevent modification of objects/projects used in model runs.
The system shall support Daymet and BiomeBGC modeling runs on the Hemisphere Linux cluster at CU.
The system shall provide context-sensitive online help in pop-up windows for all pages.
The system shall allow administrators to monitor, manage, and terminate user jobs.
The system shall allow users to share specific objects with other users or all users.
The system shall automatically create output objects upon the completion of simulation runs.
The system shall provide a mechanism for administrators to perform system consistency checks between database references and actual files on the storage system.
All login actions shall be protected by using secure data channels.
The system shall adhere to NCAR security policies and constraints.
The web portal shall be compatible with Internet Explorer 6.0, Netscape 7.1, and Safari 1.2.1.
The system shall require users to enable cookies to access the portal.
The system shall provide users with an approximate execution time estimate for model runs based on the selected computational resource.
